description:
About the company
 Our client is a healthcare company.
 The role
 Raydar is recruiting for this role on behalf of our client. Take full ownership of product features across backend services and user interfaces, from initial design through release. Suited to an early-career engineer who can deliver complete work without close direction and who can learn what the people using the product need.
 What you'll do
 - Own several internal product systems end to end, from backend design to frontend experience.
 - Build automated matching and scheduling features that weigh several criteria at once.
 - Develop predictive analytics that help improve workforce retention.
 - Build data pipelines for operational data.
 - Turn feature and automation requests into working releases, collaborating with the people who raise them face to face at times.
 - Establish clean, repeatable code patterns while using AI-assisted coding tools.
 Requirements 
 What we're looking for
 - 1 to 6 years of software engineering experience; strong new graduates are considered if they have shipped software to real users.
 - Strong full-stack skills, including designing backends that scale and that other engineers can build on.
 - Product sense and attention to detail, with the ability to deliver working features end to end without close guidance.
 - Solid design sense and comfort building user interfaces for end users.
 - Fluency with AI tools alongside a high quality bar.
 - Skill at drawing out what the people using the product actually need, including in in-person settings.
 - Able to work on site six to seven days a week, with long hours common.
 Benefits 
 Compensation and benefits
 - Base salary: USD 120,000 to 220,000 per year
 - Health, dental and vision coverage
 - Retirement plan
 Location and work model
 - San Francisco, California, United States
 - On-site, six to seven days a week
 - Full-time
